_comment: Reviewed diagnoses that refine a deterministic finding (ADR-0069). Each was reached without reading expansion source: from engine messages, bracket positions computed by code over masked text, and tools/oxp-js-lint/probe.js's redacted view. notes.py applies an entry to every finding of the expansion (url) and file whose rule matches, and whose line matches when line is given. class: content-defect = fails on every engine, not a migration regression; own-field = the expansion's own data field, not the removed API; likely-real = the removed API, probably used as SpiderMonkey meant it.

diagnoses.note: Bracket imbalance: the ')' at 195:3 closes a '{' opened at 7:29, so a '}' is missing. No engine compiles this file; the script never loaded on SpiderMonkey 1.93 either.
Bracket imbalance: the 'if (' at 112:6 is never closed (the condition is missing a ')'). No engine compiles this file; the script never loaded on SpiderMonkey 1.93 either.
Assignment to a string literal ("..." = "...";), an early error on every engine. The file reads like key = value data written as JavaScript; it never loaded on SpiderMonkey 1.93 either.
'caller' here is a key of the expansion's own options object, copied from an argument's field of the same name; it is not Function.caller. Unaffected.

A debug helper walks the call stack (var caller = f.caller, from a variable). Function.caller is undefined on QuickJS-ng, so the walk stops at once: debug output loses its call chain. Gameplay is unaffected.
The same debug stack-walking helper as Cag.station_options' cagsdebug.js. Debug output only.
